title: Granny Stripe Scarf
description: An easy scarf built from repeating cluster groups and chain spaces.
expectationText: A long repeat project where you stop counting individual stitches and start reading spaces and clusters instead.

steps.title: Foundation
steps.instruction: Chain 27 stitches or any multiple of 3 plus 3 for a wider scarf.

steps.title: Row 1
steps.instruction: Work groups of 3 double crochet with skipped spaces between them to begin the granny stripe layout.

steps.title: Row 2
steps.instruction: Chain 3, turn, and work the next groups into the spaces between the clusters from the previous row.

steps.title: Rows 3 to 24
steps.instruction: Repeat the same cluster placement into each chain space across the row until the scarf reaches your preferred length.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Fasten off, weave in ends, and add fringe only if you want extra texture.
